title: Adaptive Multi-Branching for Shallow Decision Tree Induction
abstract: arXiv:2608.29262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision trees are attractive for tabular prediction tasks because each prediction follows an interpretable sequence of feature-threshold tests. Under a strict maximum-depth budget, however, conventional binary trees can be under-expressive, since each internal node makes only a single threshold decision. We study shallow-depth tree induction, where the goal is to improve accuracy while keeping root-to-leaf paths short. We propose the Multi-Branch Neural Decision Tree with Adaptive Pruning (MBNDT), a single axis-aligned tree trained end-to-end with differentiable multi-way splits. Each internal node learns ordered thresholds over a selected feature and a branch mask that adapts its effective arity, and the trained model is converted to a deterministic single-path tree for inference. Across 21 OpenML binary-classification benchmarks, MBNDT achieves the best average rank and mean balanced accuracy among depth-constrained single-tree base

translated_title: 浅层决策树归纳的自适应多分支方法
translated_abstract: 决策树在表格预测任务中极具吸引力，因为每次预测都遵循一条可解释的特征-阈值测试序列。然而，在严格的最大深度限制下，传统的二叉树表达能力可能不足，因为每个内部节点只能做出单一的阈值决策。我们研究了浅层深度决策树的归纳方法，其目标是在保持根到叶路径较短的同时提升预测准确性。我们提出了带自适应剪枝的多分支神经决策树（MBNDT），这是一种单一的轴对齐树，通过可微的多路分裂进行端到端训练。每个内部节点在选定特征上学习有序阈值，并学习一个分支掩码来自适应地调整其有效分支数，训练好的模型会被转换为确定性的单路径树用于推理。在21个OpenML二分类基准测试中，MBNDT在深度受限的单树基线方法中取得了最佳的平均排名和平均平衡准确率。
tldr: 提出了带自适应剪枝的多分支神经决策树（MBNDT），通过可微多路分裂进行端到端训练，使浅层决策树在严格深度限制下显著提升预测准确性。
en_tdlr: Proposes MBNDT, a multi-branch neural decision tree with adaptive pruning trained end-to-end via differentiable multi-way splits, significantly improving the accuracy of shallow decision trees under strict depth constraints.
